style: Old but fair and quite good
Detailed on bridge paperwork and PMS records
Checks that log book entries match the passage plan
Asks how equipment tests are actually done

questions.q: Show the passage plan UKC calculation.
Do the deviation and revised time match?
Is the UKC alarm set for each leg?
Is the VDR microphone test mentioned in the PMS, and how do you test it?
Is the Aldis lamp in the PMS with a remark, how many batteries and what voltage is checked?
Is the radar planned maintenance recorded in the log book?
Is the HDOP comparison mentioned in each watch on deck log?
What is the radar antenna motor date?
Are watch conditions for both bridge and engine room in the passage plan and log book?
Are two-way radios tested on more channels as per the channel list, such as 13, 17, 63, 73, 74?
Are rest hours filled in every day and after each watch?
Do you read the SMS fleet broadcast?
Do you check all frequencies on MF/HF?

checks.item: Aldis lamp in PMS with battery and voltage remark
Radar planned maintenance in log book
HDOP comparison in each watch on deck log
Watch condition for bridge and engine room in passage plan and log book
Rest hours filled daily and after watch

tips: Keep the VDR mic test, Aldis lamp battery and voltage checks, and radar PM written in the PMS and log book
Record HDOP comparison in every watch on deck log
Fill rest hours daily and after each watch
Test two-way radios on more channels from the channel list, not just one
summary: SIRE inspection in Lyttelton by Capt Viraj Maki on 12.02.2026. He is old but fair and quite good, and focused on bridge paperwork: passage plan UKC, log book entries, PMS records for VDR, Aldis lamp and radar, and radio testing. The bridge part was cleared with no remark.
